title: Russia global fossil export revenue and EU total energy import costs

series.measure: CREA-estimated Russian worldwide fossil-fuel export gross revenue
series.unit: billion EUR nominal per calendar year
series.sourceLocator: CSD presentation: Russian fossil-fuel exports, Export rev table 2021–2024
series.classification: third-party modeled gross export revenue, not audited company cash receipts
caveats: CREA estimate subject to revisions, pricing and destination methodology
Oil, gas and coal combined, all global destinations
Nominal values sensitive to commodity prices and exchange rates
No claim that sanctions caused the entire revenue decline
Gross revenue not profit or net Russian fiscal receipts

series.measure: European Commission EU total energy import bill
series.unit: billion EUR nominal per calendar year
series.sourceLocator: Commission energy prices and costs report summary and 2024 State of Energy Union analysis
series.classification: total EU import bill, not Russian-only purchases or substitution incremental cost
caveats: 2021 and 2024 values sourced from different Commission report editions; reconcile coverage before cross-year inference
2024 report revision may differ from earlier published 2023 estimate
Total bill includes all origins and fuels; cannot isolate Russian supplier substitution cost
Price, consumption, exchange rates and fuel mix all contribute

crossDatasetRule: Do not subtract Russia global revenue from EU total import costs: different populations, fuels, destinations and economic concepts
sourceCorroboration: CSD reproduces CREA modeled estimates; not independent model replication
